reader.requirement: Within one program, a file-name may appear in only one SELECT clause, every SELECT file-name must have an FD in that same program's Data Division, and every FD file-name must be named by a SELECT ("specified only once" means exactly once); a contained program's FD does not satisfy the containing program's SELECT.
